question: In badminton, a quick wrist and forearm rotation that surprises an opponent by changing an apparently soft shot into a faster passing one; used primarily on the serve and at the net is known as ______
solution:
The correct answer is__** flick.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **flick** is a deceptive shot in badminton.
 
• It involves a** quick wrist and forearm rotation.**
 
• A **kill** is a powerful, **downward shot aimed to end the rally.**
 
• It is usually played close to the net.
 
• A **fault** is a** violation of the rules**, resulting in a point for the opponent.
 
• A **drop** shot is a soft shot that barely** clears the net and falls quickly.**
